en.askTitle: Put in your own state, filing status and income and get the same payments-based freelance tracker
en.runTitle: Illinois freelance designer: a tracker for about USD 85,000 of income in 2027

fields.label: Full-year payments received and deductible expenses
Other income and tax withheld
fields.placeholder: e.g. no other income and nothing withheld

fields.label: Last year’s tax and income
fields.placeholder: e.g. USD 12,000 of tax on USD 70,000 of income

fields.label: Amount saved so far and payments already made
fields.placeholder: e.g. USD 3,000 set aside and no estimated payments yet

en.template: Help me plan a cash-basis freelance tracker for {state}, with {review}, {income}, {other}, {prior} and {saved}. Separate invoices from receipts, spending from deductions, and savings from remittances. Flag assumptions to update and questions for my tax adviser. Do not make payments or submit returns.

phases.title: Confirm the official tax figures and the 2027 payment dates
phases.note: Federal and Illinois tax inputs, plus the quarterly due dates
phases.judgment: Where official 2027 figures were not available, it did not guess: the tracker uses the 2026 federal and Illinois figures, clearly labelled as fallbacks to update before any payment.

phases.title: Build the spreadsheet with made-up sample data, plus the how-to page and source notes
phases.note: Invoices, payments, expenses, a monthly summary and a quarterly tax sheet
phases.judgment: An independent reviewer read the build code and found one blocking mistake: savings transfers were not cut off at the review date, which could overstate how much was saved. The sheet now asks for transfers only up to the review date.

phases.title: Recalculate everything once, check the page and hand over
phases.judgment: It checked 3,789 formulas with zero errors and all 12 number reconciliations passing, and said plainly that later display-only edits were checked for structure but not re-rendered.

workers: Read the spreadsheet-building code on its own and checked the formula links, cash timing, part-paid invoices and tax logic

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的州、申报身份和收入，得到同样按实际收付款记账的自由职业追踪表
zh.runTitle: 伊利诺伊州自由职业设计师：为 2027 年约 8.5 万美元收入做的追踪表

fields.label: 全年收款和可扣除费用
fields.value: 预计 2027 年总收入约 8.5 万美元

fields.label: 其他收入和预扣税
fields.placeholder: 例如：没有其他收入，也没有预扣税

fields.label: 上年税额和收入
fields.placeholder: 例如：收入 7 万美元，缴税 1.2 万美元

fields.label: 已存下和已缴的金额
fields.placeholder: 例如：已存 3,000 美元，还没缴过预估税

zh.template: 请按{state}、{review}、{income}、{other}、{prior}以及{saved}，帮我规划按实际收付款记账的自由职业追踪表。分清发票与收款、支出与扣除、储蓄与缴税，提醒我要更新哪些假设、向税务顾问问什么。不要付款或提交报税表。

phases.title: 确认官方税务数字和 2027 年缴税日期
phases.note: 联邦和伊利诺伊州的税务参数，以及季度缴税日期
phases.judgment: 查不到 2027 年官方数字的地方，它没有硬编：联邦和伊利诺伊州都先用 2026 年的数字，并清楚标成“备用值”，提醒付款前一定要更新。

phases.title: 用虚构数据做出表格，并写使用说明和来源
phases.note: 发票、收款、支出、月度汇总和季度税表
phases.judgment: 一位独立审查的同事读了生成表格的代码，找到一处必须修的错误：存入储蓄的金额没有按复核日期截止，可能高估已存下的钱。表格现在要求只填复核日期之前的转账。

phases.title: 整体重算一次、检查页面并交付
phases.judgment: 它检查了 3,789 个公式，零错误，12 项数字对账全部通过；也直说之后只改了显示的几处只做了结构检查，没有重新渲染。

workers: 独立读了生成表格的代码，检查公式引用、按实际收付款的时间、发票分期收款和税务逻辑
